subtext.en: Opinion-based, argumentative, or reflective passage (10 Marks | 1 passage with MCQs + Short Answers)
subtext.hi: Opinion-based, argumentative ya reflective passage (10 Marks | 1 passage jisme MCQs + Short Answers hain)

content.en:
What is a Discursive Passage?

A discursive passage presents arguments, opinions, or reflections on a topic. It may discuss both sides of an issue, explore causes and effects, or reflect on human experiences. The tone is usually formal and thought-provoking.
content.hi:
Discursive Passage kya hota hai?

Discursive passage ek aisa text hota hai jo kisi topic pe arguments, opinions ya reflections present karta hai. Yeh issue ke dono sides discuss kar sakta hai, causes aur effects explore kar sakta hai, ya human experiences pe reflect kar sakta hai. Tone usually formal aur thought-provoking hoti hai.

content.en:
Question Types Asked

1. Comprehension questions (direct reference)
2. Inference-based questions (reading between the lines)
3. Vocabulary in context (synonyms, antonyms, meaning)
4. Analytical/evaluative questions (author's opinion, tone, purpose)
content.hi:
Kaunse Question Types aate hain?

1. Comprehension questions (direct reference se answer)
2. Inference-based questions (lines ke beech padhna)
3. Vocabulary in context (synonyms, antonyms, meaning)
4. Analytical/evaluative questions (author ki opinion, tone, purpose)

content.en:
🔥 3-Step Strategy to Score Full Marks

1. SKIM (30 seconds) — Quickly read the title, first paragraph, and last paragraph to understand the main idea.
2. READ QUESTIONS (1 minute) — Read ALL questions before reading the passage. This helps you know what to look for while reading.
3. READ + ANSWER (12-13 minutes) — Read the passage carefully. Underline keywords. Answer questions directly from the text. For vocabulary, read 2-3 lines before and after the word.
content.hi:
🔥 Full Marks Lane ki 3-Step Strategy

1. SKIM (30 seconds) — Title, first paragraph aur last paragraph quickly padho taaki main idea samajh aaye.
2. QUESTIONS PADHO (1 minute) — Passage padhne se pehle SARE questions padho. Isse pata chalta hai ki padhte waqt kya dhoondhna hai.
3. PADHO + ANSWER DO (12-13 minutes) — Passage carefully padho. Keywords underline karo. Questions directly text se answer karo. Vocabulary ke liye word ke pehle aur baad ki 2-3 lines padho.

problem.en:
The Power of Habits

Habits are the invisible architecture of daily life. Research shows that about 40% of our daily actions are not decisions but habits. When a behaviour becomes automatic, the brain stops working so hard. This is why habits are powerful — they free up mental energy for other tasks. However, breaking a bad habit or forming a good one requires understanding the habit loop: cue, routine, and reward. The cue triggers the behaviour, the routine is the behaviour itself, and the reward reinforces it. By changing the routine while keeping the same cue and reward, we can transform our habits. Small changes, consistently applied, lead to remarkable results over time.

problem.en:
The Art of Listening

In a world obsessed with speaking, listening has become a lost art. We are taught to express ourselves, to voice our opinions, to be heard. But rarely are we taught to truly listen. Active listening is not merely hearing words; it is understanding the emotions, intentions, and unspoken messages behind those words. When we listen actively, we give the speaker our full attention, make eye contact, and respond thoughtfully. This builds trust and deepens relationships. Ironically, the best communicators are often the best listeners. They understand that communication is a two-way street, and that sometimes, silence speaks louder than words.

question.en: For vocabulary questions, how many lines should you read around the word?
